meta.source: ResearchSurf 2026-11-15 (lane perceive), trimmed for the collector
meta.method: Seed list from public knowledge. Coordinates checked against CDIP MOP v1.1 backbeach points (CA, within 800 m) or Natural Earth 10m coastline (elsewhere, within 1.5 km). OSM Overpass was down (timeouts, 502) during the probe, so OSM names were not used. Facing is the CDIP MOP shore normal where available, else an 8-point seed estimate.
meta.zones_fixed: 2026-11-14 SurfCoast: Los Angeles spots moved off the uncertain Santa Barbara zones (CAZ349-350?) to the NWS LOX zones Malibu Coast CAZ362 (west of 118.55W) and Los Angeles County Beaches CAZ364.
